privacy.title: Privacy & Rules
privacy.privacyIntro: We keep your personal details safe and private.
privacy.legalSubtitle: Simple rules on how ApnaUstad protects your information and how bookings work.
privacy.localPrivacy:
1. Your Privacy Matters
Welcome to ApnaUstad! We respect your privacy and keep your personal details safe.

2. What Details We Ask For
We save your name, phone number, email, and address so Ustads and Customers can connect. For Ustads, we also check CNIC photos, skills, and rates.

3. Why We Need Them
Your details are only used to match nearby Ustads with Customers, show profiles, and let you call or chat during an active job.

4. We Never Sell Your Data
ApnaUstad never sells your phone number or personal information to advertisers or outside companies.

5. Safe & Protected
Phone numbers are hidden once a job is completed, and all account data is stored safely.
privacy.localTerms:
1. Using ApnaUstad
By using ApnaUstad, you agree to treat Customers and Ustads with respect and honesty.

2. How ApnaUstad Works
ApnaUstad connects customers with independent skilled Ustads near them. Ustads work independently and set or accept rates directly.

3. Honest Profiles
Please use your real name, phone number, and CNIC. Fake accounts or bad behavior will lead to account closure.

4. Rates & Payments
Customers pay the agreed cash amount once the work is done. Ustads keep a small wallet balance for app fees.

5. Resolving Issues
If something goes wrong during a job, use 'Report an Issue' or contact Help Center so our team can assist.
